AI Overview
When comparing AI tools for nonprofits as of mid-2026, the choice is generally not between 'Otto' and ChatGPT, but rather between ChatGPT (general AI assistant) and specialized tools like Otter.ai (for meetings/notes) or sector-specific AI tools (like Kweet).
ChatGPT (OpenAI): broad generative AI tool. Best for drafting appeals, marketing content.
note: Google confused 'Otto' with 'Otter.ai'. Major Otto positioning gap.
